defs.def: a long piece of paper, cloth, film, etc. that has been wrapped around itself or a tube several times so that it forms the shape of a tube 卷；卷轴
a paper tube wrapped around sweets/candy, etc. 一管
a small loaf of bread for one person 小面包条；小圆面包
an act of rolling the body over and over 翻滚；打滚

ex.s: "There were rolling hills of snow, a pine tree and a snowman with a hat and broom,” she recalled.
ex.t: “那里有连绵的雪丘、一棵松树，还有一个戴着帽子、拿着扫帚的雪人，”她回忆道。

ex.s: My dad and I spent the night in the guestroom of the farm house listening to the frogs and water rolling down the river nearby.
ex.t: 看到爸爸和叔叔保罗骑马让我印象深刻。

ex.s: Thousands of people were made so seasick by the rolling and violent movement of floors and streets that they were weak and bedridden for hours, and some few for even days afterwards.
ex.t: 成千上万的人因地面和街道的翻滚和剧烈晃动而严重眩晕，虚弱得卧床不起达数小时之久，少数人甚至在此后数天都卧床不起。

defs.def: a physical exercise in which you roll your body on the ground, moving your back and legs over your head 滚翻；翻跟头

ex.s: As the summer months roll in, our Georgian country estate makes the perfect setting for an outdoor fitness session.
ex.t: 来吧，在我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈的带领下，在米德尔顿庄园的场地上锻炼。

ex.s: Suddenly, Paris fell to the ground, “Paris’s eye rolled back,” Taylor says.
ex.t: 突然，帕里斯倒在地上，“帕里斯的眼睛翻了过去，”泰勒说。

defs.def: the act of moving from side to side so that one side is higher than the other 摇晃；摇荡
an area of too much fat on your body, especially around your waist 脂肪堆积的部位，肥胖的部位（尤指腰部）
an official list of names 花名册；名单
a deep continuous sound 隆隆声；持续的轰鸣声

ex.s: Thinking Like a Mountain A deep chesty bawl echoes from rimrock to rimrock, rolls down the mountain, and fades into the far blackness of the night.
ex.t: 像山一样思考 一声低沉浑厚的嚎叫从岩壁间回荡，滚下山坡，消失在远方的黑夜中。

defs.def: an act of rolling a dice 掷骰子
to turn over and over and move in a particular direction; to make a round object do this （使）翻滚，滚动

ex.s: Before I could turn and find the door, there came a huge shock; the ground seemed to roll under me in waves, interrupted by a violent shaking up and down.
ex.t: 我还没来得及转身找到门，就传来了一阵巨大的震动；地面似乎在波浪中翻滚，夹杂着猛烈的上下摇晃。

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前袋少充气，团队让载树的平台在保持水平的情况下滚上坡道出坑，拖车拖着树前行，成员们从平台后方取下气囊补到前方。

defs.def: to turn over and over or round and round while remaining in the same place; to make sth do this （使）原地转圈，原地打转
to turn over to face a different direction; to make sb/sth do this （使）翻身，翻转
to move smoothly (on wheels or as if on wheels); to make sth do this （使）滚动，移动

ex.s: Turner wisely said that “doing well” psychologically is being able to roll with the flow of emotions, manage them, communicate clearly and well with others, and master various skills.
ex.t: 特纳明智地说，“从心理上讲”“做得好”是能够顺应情绪的流动，管理情绪，与他人清晰良好地沟通，并掌握各种技能。“

defs.def: to make sth/yourself into the shape of a ball or tube 使 … 成球状（或管状）

ex.s: Finally, with just two minutes to spare we rolled into the bus station.
ex.t: 最后，我们提前两分钟赶到了汽车站。

ex.s: Finally, with just two minutes to spare we rolled into the bus station.
ex.t: 最后，我们提前两分钟赶到了汽车站。

defs.def: to fold the edge of a piece of clothing, etc. over and over on itself to make it shorter 把（衣服的边）卷起来

ex.s: We passed it, he tried to put it in his mouth, he tried bouncing it, rolling it, sitting on it, throwing it.
ex.t: 我们路过它时，他试图把它放进嘴里，又试着弹它、滚它、坐在上面、扔它。

defs.def: to make sth flat by pushing sth heavy over it 使平坦；压平
to wrap or cover sb/sth/yourself in sth （用某物）包裹，覆盖
to move or make sth move from side to side （使）摇摆，摇晃
to make a long continuous sound 发出持续的声音

ex.s: Even without sight or sound of wolf, it is implicit in a hundred small events: the midnight whinny of a pack horse, the rattle of rolling rocks, the bound of a fleeing deer, the way shadows lie under the spruces.
ex.t: 即使没有狼的目光或声音，它也隐含在一百个小事件中：一匹包马的午夜呜咽，滚滚的岩石的响响，一头逃跑的鹿的束缚，阴影埋伏在树丛下的方式。

defs.def: when a machine rolls or sb rolls it, it operates 启动；开动

ex.s: When Emily rolled down the window, Rachel asked if she was okay and told her it was not safe to stay overnight in the car.
ex.t: 当Emily摇下车窗时，Rachel问她是否还好，并告诉她整夜待在车里不安全。

defs.def: to turn or force sth back or further away 击退；使后退
to reduce prices, etc. 降低，削减（价格等）
to open sth by turning a handle 摇开；旋开
to make a rolled piece of clothing, etc. hang or lie flat 展开，铺开，摊开（卷状物）
to arrive in great numbers or amounts 大量涌入；滚滚而来
to arrive late at a place, without seeming worried or sorry 姗姗来迟
to make sth flat by pushing sth over it 将 … 轧平

ex.s: Using the first set of airbags, the movers rolled the platform into the new hole.
ex.t: 白色气囊然后在约半小时内放气以将巨杉的根球降到坑底，气囊被移走了，但钢棒留在了树上因为它们会在数年内生锈降解。

defs.def: to officially make a new product available or start a new political campaign 正式推出（新产品）；开展（新的政治运动）

ex.s: There are now 700 elderly people looking after hens in 20 care homes in the North East, and the charity has been given financial support to roll it out countrywide.
ex.t: 如今英格兰东北部20家养老院里有700名老人在照料母鸡，该慈善机构已获得财政支持，计划在全国范围内推广。
